subject: StormBridge hands-on kickoff & orchestration — scheduling and action plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Palmer <alex@stormbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: StormBridge POC — hands-on kickoff & load-test windows

Alex —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a hands-on POC kickoff that combines: prompt walkthrough, routing/LLM variant discussion, and a short alpha load test to validate throughput and latency assumptions. Goals for the session (90–120m):

- Walk through 5 canonical prompts and expected response constraints (prompt review)
- Routing: show policy-based routing vs. cost-latency fallback
- Run a 10–15 minute alpha load profile (non-production tokens, capped) to validate batching and KV-cache behavior

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 9/13 10:00–11:45
- Thu 9/14 10:00–11:45
- Fri 9/15 13:00–14:45

Please pick one that works for your team and let me know who will join from StormBridge (we recommend the ML lead, SRE/infra contact, and product owner).

Pre-reads: agenda attached (RB-stormbridge-agenda-v1.pdf) and a short runbook will follow. For the load test we’ll need a test endpoint allowlist (IP/CIDR) and a temporary API key — if you can pre-provision those that will speed things up.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RB-stormbridge-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda PDF, 2 pages)

From: Alex Palmer <alex@stormbridge.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Gautham <priya@stormbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 13:14:22 -0400
Subject: Re: StormBridge POC — hands-on kickoff & load-test windows

Thanks Kimberly — really helpful framing. We are keen to run this. Priya (cc'd) will lead the ML side; I'll get SRE to join as well.

Quick note: I have a board meeting on Wed morning that ran long last week — Thu 9/14 looks best for me. If Thu is available we'll take the 10:00 slot.

Also: one constraint — we need the load test window to be limited to 15 minutes and capped qps to 50; can Redwood enforce that from your side? If so, we can sign off on a short test.

Appreciate it,
Alex
CTO | StormBridge

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Palmer <alex@stormbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StormBridge POC — hands-on kickoff & load-test windows

Alex — Thu 9/14 10:00 PT works for our team; locking that in now. Calendar invite and dial-in to follow.

Two quick clarifications for the load test:
1) We can enforce a 15-minute window and set a qps cap at 50 from our side (we'll configure a rate limiter on the route used for the test).
2) For allowlisting we'll need either an IP/CIDR or temporary SSH hostnames for the SRE team. Can you provide that by Thursday 08:00 PT?

Internal ask (Ben/Marcus): Marcus, can you prepare a 10-minute demo of routing fallbacks + one quantized model variant we can bring up quickly? Ben, I'll need the shared invite and HubSpot update after the session.

I'll upload the runbook to Drive; sending the internal copy in a separate message.

Thanks,
Kimberly

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: StormBridge sync — runbook & roles (internal)

Ben/Marcus — quick internal note (not for external):

Attached: runbook-stormbridge-v1.pdf (internal runbook — includes step-by-step for load test, rollback, and telemetry checks)

Session flow (45m demo, 30–45m hands-on):
- 0–10m: intro + success criteria
- 10–25m: prompt walkthrough & expected outputs (Marcus to lead)
- 25–40m: routing policies and model variants (Marcus)
- 40–85m: hands-on with StormBridge prompts (we provide ephemeral API key)
- 85–95m: alpha load test (15m, qps capped)
- 95–105m: immediate triage & observations, capture metrics

Roles:
- Marcus: demo & routing, will open quantized model instance
- Ben: manage calendar and HubSpot; will capture notes in the deal record
- Kimberly: host, coordinate attendees, own action log

Prep checklist (for next morning):
- Runbook uploaded to Drive (link will be in external invite)
- Temporary API key created (ops)
- Rate limiter and qps cap configured on the test route (infra)

Let's sync 09:45 PT on Thu for a 15-min readiness check.

-K

From: Alex Palmer <alex@stormbridge.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Gautham <priya@stormbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 10:03:15 -0400
Subject: Re: StormBridge POC — hands-on kickoff & load-test windows

Kimberly — confirmed for Thu 9/14 10:00 PT. Attendees from our side: Priya Gautham (ML Lead), Tom Sato (SRE), and Mira Chen (Product).

We created a short constraints file (attached) with IP ranges and one-off rate limits; you'll see it attached as stormbridge-constraints.txt. We will not exceed the 15-minute window.

One ask: can you share an editable version of the prompt set before the session? We'd like to flag three prompts for complexity that may need different routing.

See you shortly,
Alex

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Palmer <alex@stormbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: StormBridge — session recap + actions (follow-up)

Alex/Priya/Tom/Mira —

Thanks again for the hands-on session this morning. Short recap and owners below. Recording and artifacts are linked.

What we covered:
- Prompt review: ran 5 canonical prompts, identified 3 complexity cases (P1–P3) that need routing rules
- Routing & model variants: demonstrated cost-sensitive fallback — Marcus booted a 4-bit quantized variant for P2
- Alpha load test: 15-minute run, qps capped at 50, peak tokens/sec within expected range; no throttles observed

Action items (owner — due):
- Provide updated prompt annotations and suggested routing tags (StormBridge: Priya) — due 2028-09-21
- Implement route with qps cap and test key on staging (Redwood: Marcus) — due 2028-09-18
- HubSpot notes + next-session survey + meeting invite with proposed topics (Redwood: Ben) — due 2028-09-15
- Exchange security checklist (StormBridge: Tom) — due 2028-09-19

Next session: propose a 60–75m follow-up week of 9/25–9/29 focusing on routing rules, regression tests, and extended load validation. Please reply with preferred dates/times.

Links & artifacts:
- Runbook: https://drive.google.com/stormbridge/POC-agenda
- Session recording: https://redwood-recordings.s3.amazonaws.com/20280914-stormbridge-session.mp4
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/STORM-2028-019

Attachments: runbook-stormbridge-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
